items.content_html: A lightweight single-page web app to track your exam journey. Features a bold 3D “days left” hero, real-time circular ring + progress bar, and a React-powered calendar to rate daily productivity with color-coded cells. Runs on pure HTML/CSS/JS+React UMD, saves to localStorage, no backend, modern glassy UI, responsive, subtle motion.
